newsitem.title: USA: Republic to buy Silver State assets.
newsitem.headline: Republic to buy Silver State assets.

text.p: Republic Industries Inc said Tuesday it had signed a definitive agreement to acquire a Las Vegas garbage collection company in a stock deal valued at $378 million.
Republic said in a statement it had agreed to acquire Silver State Disposal Service Inc and related businesses in exchange for common stock.
It said Silver State had about $126 million of revenue last year.
"This acquisition furthers our strategy of expanding into growing markets in the western United States," it said.
Republic's stock closed at 24-3/4 on Tuesday, down 1/4 from the previous day's close.
On July 22, the company signed a definitive agreement to buy the Anderson Dealership Group for about $40 million in stock.
Republic Industries operates subsidiaries in the automotive retailing, automotive rental, automotive financial services, solid waste services, and electronic security services industries.
